## R6.8 — RUNNER-CORE (a)+(b) · manifest 261 · INFRA · offline-only · $0.00

New workspace crate **`hharness-runner`** + binary **`hh-runner`** — the committed offline experiment runner. It *drives* `hh-experiment`'s `ExperimentEngine` (`next → claim → launch → settle` under the spec's `ReattemptPolicy`) and keeps **no** scheduler, retry counter or authoritative store of its own (CC1, K-2). Offline-only; zero production mutations.

### Process topology (REQ-XB-104 evidence)
- **coordinator** — sole writer of the experiment store root; owns the engine drive loop and durable-derived recovery; spawns workers.
- **slot-worker** — one process per in-flight attempt; sole writer of its own slot store root; runs §3.3 ST0–ST7 (admit → provision → phase rows → `submission_seal` → retained grade attempts → one `hh-experiment-slot/1` record blob → `lifecycle.run.finished{slot_record_ref, slot_ref}`).
- **store-probe** — the topology spike: a second process reads a root a live writer holds (committed prefix only) and a second writer on a held run is refused `WouldBlock`.
- `max_parallel_slots` bounds in-flight workers (process-level concurrency).

### Slot record (REQ-XB-108)
One `hh-experiment-slot/1` record per slot — a runner-crate codec over canonical JSON (not `hh-embed-schema`), full §3.3 sections. The closed `withheld{…}` member set: `admission:<r>` (`AG1–AG9` + the §3.3 ST0/named-hold reasons), `budget`, `window_deadline`, `image_drift`, `dataset_private`, `no_candidate`, `inert_predicted`, `inert_at_admissible_window`, `infra`, `l1_not_passed`, `sealed_until_results` — unknown members refuse, never relabel. `costs{model,compute}` are `{schema:"hh-slot-costs/1", ref}` references only — a value member is a duplicated fold and is refused. `identity.runner{driver_commit, binary_sha256}` on every record.

### Outcome map (REQ-XB-120 / §3.3)
The full table: `scored` → `executed{resolved|unresolved}` (any end cause incl. `agent_timeout`/`budget_refused`/`crashed`/`relay_killed_by_agent`), `oracle_failure` → `inconclusive{verifier_unavailable:<c>}`, `infrastructure_failure` → `inconclusive{infra:<c>}` (the single replanning class), `refused` → `withheld{admission:<r>}`, `cancelled` → `inconclusive{cancelled}`. **Premature-refusal precedence:** a premature slot budget refusal is `infrastructure_failure` even with a valid reward (RD-17). Pinned one-to-one Harbor `error_policy` cause map included.

### Recovery (REQ-XB-105)
Resume derives only from durable records: launched-but-unsettled attempts bind the worker's sealed record (subject finished row copies `stop_reason`/`outcome_class`/`disposition` verbatim + `slot_store{root_digest, run_id, head_hash}`) or close `inconclusive{infra:runner_crash}` and replan — a paid agent phase is never resumed mid-run; the retried slot is a NEW attempt. No `Path::exists`-style skips (scan in battery).

### K-2 edge gate (REQ-XB-103 / AR-04)
`scripts/check-runner-edges.sh` + ci.yml step `Runner K-2 edge check (AR-04)` forbid any `cargo tree` edge into hh-embed/hh-cli/hosting/kernel/orchestrator/fleet; `scripts/ci/test-check-runner-edges.sh` proves the seeded-edge negative leg. ADR-0427 records the placement ruling (live Harbor/O-surface admission → R6.17 dated addendum).
